/*selectMasterCmClClosingTotalList*/
SELECT X.* FROM ( SELECT (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C001' AND COMPANY_CODE='KRKORE0001' AND CODE=A.DEPT_CODE) AS DEPT_NAME , DECODE(A.TYPE, 'M', 'MRO', 'J', '재고') AS TYPE_TEXT , SUM(A.ITEM_AMT) AS ITEM_AMT , SUM(A.W_AMT) AS W_AMT , MAX(NVL(B.J_AMT, 0)) AS J_AMT , SUM(A.W_AMT) + MAX(NVL(B.J_AMT, 0)) AS WJ_AMT , MAX(B.REMARK) AS REMARK , A.YYYYMM , A.DEPT_CODE , A.TYPE FROM KEP_SUBUL_MNG A /* 수불관리 */ , KEP_SUBUL_JOJUNG B /* 수불조정 */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.YYYYMM = #{st_from_date} AND A.YYYYMM = B.YYYYMM(+) AND A.DEPT_CODE = B.DEPT_CODE(+) AND A.TYPE = B.TYPE(+) GROUP BY A.YYYYMM , A.DEPT_CODE , A.TYPE ) X ORDER BY X.DEPT_NAME , X.TYPE DESC
